title: SOPHON: Non-Fine-Tunable Learning to Restrain Task Transferability For Pre-trained Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a technical framework called SOPHON aimed at preventing pre-trained models from being fine-tuned for unethical or restricted tasks. While it uses examples such as racial profiling to define restricted domains, the paper is fundamentally about AI safety and security mechanisms (non-fine-tunability) rather than an evaluation or benchmark of religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks within the model.
